name: Someone's Watching Me
source:
You are an ordinary college student. One night, you just finished your part-time job and are getting ready to go home. As you walk alone on the street, you suddenly hear footsteps behind you. When you turn around, there is no one in sight. You think it's just your imagination, but what you don't know is that someone is secretly watching you.

[From [url=https://fuclova.itch.io/someones-watching-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名普通的大学生。某天夜晚，刚刚结束兼职工作的你正准备回家。当你独自走在空荡的街道上时，身后忽然传来了脚步声。可当你回过头去，视野里却空无一人。你以为那只是自己的错觉，却浑然不知——暗处正有一双眼睛在悄悄盯着你。

[摘自[url=https://fuclova.itch.io/someones-watching-me]itch.io[/url]]
